description: This file defines an abstract base class 'DateElementBase' for date form elements in Drupal, providing methods for calculating date ranges and retrieving element titles.

classes.name: DateElementBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for date form elements, including range calculation and title retrieval.

methods.name: datetimeRangeYears
methods.description: Calculates a dynamic range of years based on a string pattern and optional date object.

methods.name: getElementTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the most relevant title for a date element, checking the element itself or its parent container.
